title: Varamu 2 – Enoch Abraham Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: ధైర్యము వీడని దాసులము – పరాక్రమమే మా బలము
యెహోవా మా పక్షమై యుండగా – యేసయ్య రక్తమే మాకు తోడుగా
యెహోవా మా పక్షమై యుండగా – యేసయ్య రక్తమే మాకు తోడుగా ధ్వజముగా నిలువగా
english: Dairyamu veedani daasulamu – paraakramame maa balamu
Yohavaa maa pakshamai yundagaa – yesayya rakthame maaku thoduga
Yohavaa maa pakshamai yundagaa – yesayya rakthame maaku thoduga dwajamuga niluvaga
translation: Chorus
We are kings and priests, heirs of the King of kings.
We are servants who never lose courage, and bravery is our strength.
When the Lord is on our side and the blood of Jesus stands with us as our banner,
we will perform courageous and mighty deeds.
When He raises us up and fills us with His Spirit and power,
the miracles that seem amazing to the world become our mission and calling.
Rapha – the Lord our healer.
Verse 1
Even a cloth can show the way through a river,
and even a staff can split the sea.
If dry bones can receive life,
is anything impossible for the living God?
Those who stood in the fire were not burned,
and those surrounded by lions were not shaken.
Kings fall and mighty warriors tremble
when God stands with us and His commands change everything.
He can turn the earth upside down
and destroy the plans of accusation and opposition.
He has given us authority and power,
so miracles that amaze the world become our work.
Shamma – the Lord who is present with us.
Verse 2
Jesus spoke even with death itself,
and with songs the very foundations were shaken.
Ordinary people began to perform miracles,
and the humble stood boldly with courage.
With just His word and even His shadow, miracles happened,
because the unchanging God is with us.
Invisible enemies cannot prevail
when the protecting God lives within you.
If Jesus walks before you,
who can rise against you?
If you simply believe, He will accomplish great works.
Kadosh – Holy, Holy, Holy.
Bridge
The Risen One—Jesus is alive.
The Risen One lives within us.
The Risen One comforts us.
The Risen One gives us authority.
The Risen One makes us victorious.
The Risen One reigns as King.
The Risen One gives His kingdom.
Messiah!
The kingdom, the glory, the honor, and the power
belong forever to the Lamb of God.

credits.Produced: K. Shyam Kishore & K. Asha Kiran

intro: Varamu 2 is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Shadrach, sung by Enoch Abraham and music composed by Nikhil Paul, produced by K. Shyam Kishore, K. Asha Kiran. This song was released on March 12, 2026, through Jesus Christ of Nazareth Ministries – JCNM YouTube Channel.
